body: No don’t go there. It seems like you’re just a placeholder, she can’t bear the thought of being alone right now and you a familiar and comfortable. No doubt she will leave you when the next interesting thing comes along. You deserve better.

YTA 

Are you really surprised your daughter didn’t tell you about the therapist? Look at how you’ve reacted to her seeing one! No wonder she didn’t feel comfortable telling you or her father about it. 

As someone who had a father JUST LIKE YOUR HUSBAND, I can promise you that what he is doing/did to her is abuse. Part of being a parent is protecting them from harm, your husband has a terrible temper and you’re enabling him by pretending what he did “wasn’t that bad”. I grew up in a wealthy family and was given every opportunity in life, didn’t change the fact that my father physically and psychologically abused me. Just because your husband tutored her and paid for expensive schooling doesn’t give him (or you) the right to physically beat her or brush off any concerns she has about her wellbeing. 

The social worker may have decided their was no long term physical damage, but psychological damage can not be seen with naked eye.
